shared colonial minimum duration versus butterfly resource delta controlling geography native composition and climate

randomization.method: permute the complete 4-empire region vector at region nodes within WGSRPD level1, keeping pairs and outcomes unchanged
randomization.caveat: post-hoc exploratory geographic strata not exact randomization inference

interpretation_limits: WCVP current nonnative ranges are not specifically date-verified colonial imports
Source historical durations are weighted across heterogeneous regional geometry, and may refer to different periods
A positive conditional association is not causal mediation or evidence of movement of particular butterflies
Shared colonial history does not imply direct historical ship route or trade volume
Only source-matched 239 potential butterfly resource species, not realized butterfly communities
